in_hebrew.long_meaning: Derry הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Irish mythology, Derry was believed to be a sacred oak grove, a place of refuge, and a center of ancient religious and spiritual practices. In Christian tradition, Derry is associated with Saint Colmcille, who is said to have founded the city in the 6th century.
